headline: Executive order changes earlier tariffs on imports from Canada that were tied to concerns about illegal drugs crossing the northern border.
what_it_does: This order amends an earlier order that placed duties, which are taxes on imported goods, on products coming from across the U.S. northern border with Canada. The earlier duties were linked to efforts to reduce the flow of illegal drugs into the United States. The title shows the order changes those duties, but no summary was provided, so the exact changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. businesses that import goods from Canada
who_it_affects.how: The taxes they pay on Canadian imports may change under the amended rules.

who_it_affects.group: Canadian exporters selling to the United States
who_it_affects.how: The duties applied to their products entering the U.S. may be adjusted.
